```yaml
name: Stale issues and PRs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 1 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Mark stale issues and pull requests
        uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          stale-issue-message: |
            This issue has been marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. If you are still working on it, please comment or update it to keep it active. Thank you!
          stale-pr-message: |
            This pull request has been marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. If you are still working on it, please comment or update it to keep it active. Thank you!
          close-issue-message: |
            Closing this issue due to inactivity. If you believe this is a mistake, please comment and we will reopen it.
          close-pr-message: |
            Closing this pull request due to inactivity. If you believe this is a mistake, please comment and we will reopen it.
          days-before-stale: 90
          days-before-close: 60
          stale-issue-label: stale
          close-issue-label: closed
          exempt-issue-labels: lifecycle/frozen,help-wanted,good-first-issue,pinned
          exempt-pr-labels: lifecycle/frozen,help-wanted,good-first-issue,pinned
```
